espera.lunaeternal.empieza: §8» §7Don't move for §f%s seconds§7 and you'll be teleported.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.derrota: You lost to %s. Come back when you are ready.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.blaine.lleno: Riddle me this! What is packed, takes no one else, and burns? Answer: my gym. Come back later.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.blaine.no_pued: Not yet. Come back when you are ready.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.blaine.reto: My Pokemon burn. Are you here to burn, or to put me out?
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.blaine.ya_gana: You have already beaten me. That badge is yours.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.brock.lleno: Not right now: there's a new nurse at the Pokemon Center and I must introduce myself. Come back in a while... or two.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.brock.no_puede: Not yet. Come back when you are ready.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.brock.reto: My defence is made of rock, and it does not give. If you think you can break it, come in.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.brock.ya_ganad: You have already beaten me. That badge is yours.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.bugsy.lleno: Está lleno. Aprovecho para catalogar unos escarabajos, no tardo… mucho.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.bugsy.no_puede: Todavía no. Vuelve cuando estés preparado.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.bugsy.reto: He estudiado a los Pokémon insecto más que nadie. Y aun así siguen sorprendiéndome.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.bugsy.ya_ganad: Ya me has ganado. Apunté todos tus movimientos, por cierto.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.chuck.lleno: ¡Todo ocupado! Voy a partir unos troncos mientras esperas. ¡Únete!
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.chuck.no_puede: Todavía no. Vuelve cuando estés preparado.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.chuck.reto: ¡He entrenado bajo una cascada durante un mes! ¿Y tú?
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.clair.lleno: Está lleno, y no pienso repetírtelo. Vuelve más tarde.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.clair.no_puede: Todavía no. Vuelve cuando estés preparado.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.clair.reto: Soy la mejor entrenadora de dragones del mundo. No lo olvides.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.clair.ya_ganad: Ya me has ganado. …No lo vayas contando por ahí.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.erika.lleno: Sorry... I dozed off among the flowers again. And it's full, too. Come back later, would you?
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.erika.no_puede: Not yet. Come back when you are ready.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.erika.reto: Plants grow slowly and endure a lot. Let us see how much you endure.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.erika.ya_ganad: You have already beaten me. That badge is yours.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.falkner.lleno: Ahora no puedo: se me han escapado los pájaros otra vez. Vuelve en un rato.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.falkner.no_pue: Todavía no. Vuelve cuando estés preparado.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.falkner.reto: Los Pokémon pájaro son los mejores. Te lo voy a demostrar desde arriba.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.falkner.ya_gan: Ya me has ganado. El cielo es tuyo.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.giovanni.lleno: My schedule is full. And believe me: you would not enjoy what I do to those who insist.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.giovanni.no_pu: Not yet. Come back when you are ready.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.giovanni.reto: I am the last obstacle. And I am not one to step aside.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.giovanni.ya_ga: You have already beaten me. That badge is yours.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.jasmine.lleno: Ay… está lleno, y me da vergüenza decírtelo. Vuelve luego, ¿sí?
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.jasmine.no_pue: Todavía no. Vuelve cuando estés preparado.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.jasmine.reto: Perdona, soy un poco tímida… pero mis Pokémon de acero no lo son.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.jasmine.ya_gan: Ya me has ganado. Lo hiciste muy bien, de verdad.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.koga.lleno: A good ninja knows how to wait. And right now you have no choice: the gym is full.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.koga.no_puedes: Not yet. Come back when you are ready.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.koga.reto: Poison needs no strength, only time. Do you have time?
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.koga.ya_ganada: You have already beaten me. That badge is yours.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.misty.lleno: I'm busy. Still looking for a certain trainer who has owed me a bicycle for years. You wouldn't be a friend of his?
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.misty.no_puede: Not yet. Come back when you are ready.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.misty.reto: My policy is an all-out offensive with water Pokemon. Dare you?
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.misty.ya_ganad: You have already beaten me. That badge is yours.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.morty.lleno: Está lleno. Aunque si te quedas muy quieto, igual ves algo entre las sombras.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.morty.no_puede: Todavía no. Vuelve cuando estés preparado.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.morty.reto: Llevo años esperando ver al Pokémon legendario. Mientras tanto, peleo.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.morty.ya_ganad: Ya me has ganado. Lo vi venir, pero no pude evitarlo.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.pryce.lleno: Está lleno. Ten paciencia: el hielo tarda, y aun así siempre llega.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.pryce.no_puede: Todavía no. Vuelve cuando estés preparado.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.pryce.reto: El hielo enseña paciencia. Yo llevo cincuenta años aprendiendo.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.pryce.ya_ganad: Ya me has ganado. Recordaré este combate.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.sabrina.lleno: I knew you would come today. What I did not see is that it would be full. Apparently even I miss things.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.sabrina.no_pue: Not yet. Come back when you are ready.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.sabrina.reto: I knew you would come. I also know how this ends. Shall we?
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.sabrina.ya_gan: You have already beaten me. That badge is yours.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.surge.lleno: All lanes taken, recruit! Use the time for push-ups. I want you back here in five!
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.surge.no_puede: Not yet, recruit. Come back when you are ready.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.surge.reto: In the army I learned that electricity decides battles. Ready, recruit?
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.surge.ya_ganad: You have already beaten me, recruit. That badge is yours.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.whitney.lleno: ¡Está lleeeeno! Y me voy a poner a llorar si insistes. Vuelve luego.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.whitney.no_pue: Todavía no. Vuelve cuando estés preparado.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.whitney.reto: ¡Vamos, que esto va a ser divertido! …para mí.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.dice.whitney.ya_gan: Ya me has ganado. Y no lloré. Casi.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.no.combate: The battle could not be started.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.no.faltan: You need %s more badges to challenge this leader.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.no.lleno: No free rooms right now. Try again in a minute.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.no.sin_construir: Their gym is still being built.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.no.sin_lider: The leader has not arrived yet.
gimnasio.lunaeternal.no.sin_pokemon: You have no Pokemon in your party.
gimnasios.lunaeternal.estado.faltan: You need %s more badges to challenge them.
gimnasios.lunaeternal.estado.listo: You can challenge them. Talk to them in the citadel.
gimnasios.lunaeternal.estado.proximament: Their gym is still being built.
item.lunaeternal.sobre.luna.desc: §6Better odds of rare and legendary cards.
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.cazas.desc: The current targets and their reward
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.clan.desc: Your people: found one or join another
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.curar.desc: Get your team back to full, free
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.explorar.desc: The world, its zones and what spawns where
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.gts.desc: Buy and sell Pokemon with the whole server
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.gyms.desc: Badges and where each leader is
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.misiones.desc: What to do next, and what it pays
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.pokedex.desc: Every species you have seen and caught
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.tesoros.desc: Chests and keys. Odds are public
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.tienda.desc: Poke Balls, potions and whatever else you need
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.trabajos.desc: Earn PokeDollars mining, fishing and farming
pokepad.lunaeternal.app.wiki.desc: How everything works, without leaving the game
pokepad.lunaeternal.cartas.diario.desc: Free every 24 h. Uncommon and below.
pokepad.lunaeternal.cartas.explica: Card packs of your Pokemon. One free a day, and as many as you like with LunaCoins.
pokepad.lunaeternal.cartas.luna.desc: No limit. Better rares and legendaries, and a divine ticket every 10.
pokepad.lunaeternal.cartas.plata.desc: One more every 24 h. Uncommon and below.
pokepad.lunaeternal.cartas.sin_mod: Cards are not active on this server.
pokepad.lunaeternal.caza.elige: Pick a target to see it up close.
pokepad.lunaeternal.clan.etiqueta_ayuda: 2 to 5 letters. Shown next to your name.
pokepad.lunaeternal.clan.sin_clanes: No clans yet. Found the first one.
pokepad.lunaeternal.clan.sin_movimientos: Nothing has gone in or out yet.
pokepad.lunaeternal.clan.solo_invitacion: Clans are invite-only. Talk to their members.
pokepad.lunaeternal.clan.tesoro_ayuda: Only officers and the leader can withdraw.
pokepad.lunaeternal.curar.explica: Heals your whole team and clears status conditions. It's free.
pokepad.lunaeternal.curar.sano: Your team is in perfect shape
pokepad.lunaeternal.explorar.hogar_desc: Your home. What you build here is protected.
pokepad.lunaeternal.explorar.hogar_largo: The permanent world. Claim land and build without anyone touching it. In exchange, few Pokémon spawn and there are no legendaries.
pokepad.lunaeternal.explorar.reparto: There are three wild worlds and you're sent to the emptiest one, to avoid crowding. To go with a clanmate, pick them below.
pokepad.lunaeternal.explorar.salvaje_lar: No claims: you don't build here, you explore. Many more Pokémon and a chance of legendaries. It resets every week, so don't leave anything you'd miss.
pokepad.lunaeternal.explorar.sin_clan: Nobody from your clan is in the wild right now.
pokepad.lunaeternal.gts.elige: Pick an offer from the list to see its details.
pokepad.lunaeternal.gts.elige_mia: Pick one of your offers to view or withdraw it.
pokepad.lunaeternal.gts.elige_tuyo: Pick one of your Pokemon to put up for sale.
pokepad.lunaeternal.gts.sin_pokemon: You have no Pokemon to sell.
pokepad.lunaeternal.inicial.fallo: No answer. Try again, or rejoin
pokepad.lunaeternal.mercado.elige_tuyo: Pick something from your bag to put up for sale.
pokepad.lunaeternal.mercado.tasa_perdida: The listing fee is not refunded.
pokepad.lunaeternal.necesitas_pokemon: You need a %s in your party to use this outfit.
pokepad.lunaeternal.ordenar.coge: Pick an icon to move it
pokepad.lunaeternal.parada.centro_curaci: Heal your team for free. Every 30 minutes.
pokepad.lunaeternal.parada.laboratorio.d: Where it all starts. Pick your first Pokémon here.
pokepad.lunaeternal.parada.montana.desc: The highest point of the citadel. You can see it all from here.
pokepad.lunaeternal.parada.monumentos.de: For those who are no longer with us. Every player has a place here.
pokepad.lunaeternal.parada.palacio.desc: The trainers' seat. Ranks, achievements and recognition.
pokepad.lunaeternal.parada.torre_batalla: Where you fight. Challenges, battles and the trainer ladder.
pokepad.lunaeternal.parada.torre_comerci: Trade: shop, market and everything bought and sold.
pokepad.lunaeternal.traje.campeon: The one with badges. Golden armor and the jeweled crown.
pokepad.lunaeternal.traje.elite: The one who wins battles now. Headband and the first plates.
pokepad.lunaeternal.traje.entrenador: Chainmail with Protection I. Claim it every 24 h and it's really yours.
pokepad.lunaeternal.traje.leyenda: The myth. Arceus’ helm, his armor and the wheel on his back.
pokepad.lunaeternal.traje.maestro: The one who teaches. Long coat, full cape and gauntlets.
pokepad.lunaeternal.trajes.ayuda: Your rank gives you the outfit, and you can wear any up to yours. It gives no protection and no advantage: it's only how you look.
pokepad.lunaeternal.trajes.bloqueado: You don't own this one yet
pokepad.lunaeternal.trajes.sin_arte: This outfit isn't drawn yet. It will show up here when it is.
pokepad.lunaeternal.viajes.fuera: This will take you out of this world
pokepad.lunaeternal.viajes.fuera_largo: You're outside the citadel: travelling will take you there.
tesoros.lunaeternal.falta_juego: Play to earn your key. Idle time doesn't count.
tesoros.lunaeternal.sin_llaves: §cYou have no keys for that crate.
tesoros.lunaeternal.ya_reclamada: You already took today's key. Come back tomorrow.
